Born in Germany, 31 May 1742. He and his wife, Maria Catharina Burchert, lived at Hanover,
York County, Pennsylvania, where he died on 17 November 1780, aged 38.
He was buried in the Emanuel Reformed churchyard.
His stone has long since gone, but his brother Peter was buried beside him nine years later.
Their son George (1776 to 1840) stayed in Hanover.
